title: Ecommerce Email/SMS Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month


To be considered for this role please apply and follow/connect with our CEO (Andrew Giessinger):

description:

You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio

  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

description:

Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)

  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles

  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications

title: Gerente de Produto e Serviços Técnicos Sênior SAR
description:
A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

Na Phibro, as pessoas são nosso maior patrimônio. Nós nos esforçamos para desenvolver uma força de trabalho diversificada que promova um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam apoiadas em compartilhar abertamente sua criatividade e habilidades que lhes permitam ser o mais bem-sucedidas possível.   • Gerenciar o portfólio regional, revisando o mix de produtos e identificando oportunidades de lançamentos, atualizações ou descontinuações com base no ciclo de vida, desempenho e potencial de mercado.
  • Estabelecer e revisar estratégias de precificação, equilibrando competitividade e rentabilidade.
  • Monitorar mensalmente os indicadores-chave de desempenho (volume, preço e lucratividade), propondo ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.
  • Gerir o orçamento de marketing da linha, garantindo alocação eficiente dos recursos e avaliação de retorno sobre investimento.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de campanhas e materiais de marketing em parceria com equipes internas e agências, incluindo conteúdos técnicos e promocionais.
  • Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, produzindo análises que subsidiem decisões estratégicas e oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Participar do processo de S&OP, assegurando alinhamento entre planejamento de marketing, previsão de demanda e disponibilidade de produtos.
  • Planejar e coordenar estudos de campo, testes e validações científicas, garantindo consistência técnica e conformidade regulatória.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com consultores, universidades e formadores de opinião (KOLs), ampliando a credibilidade técnica da marca.
  • Participar de visitas estratégicas e discussões técnicas com clientes-chave, contribuindo diretamente para decisões, relacionamento e posicionamento da marca.
  • Priorizar atividades de alto impacto, evitando envolvimento em rotinas operacionais de campo.
  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos internos durante reuniões periódicas, promovendo a capacitação contínua da equipe de vendas.

  • Representar a empresa como porta-voz técnico em eventos, congressos e fóruns do setor.
  • Promover o alinhamento técnico entre os países da região (SAR) , compartilhando melhores práticas e padronizando o posicionamento dos produtos.

Remote | Full-time | Core hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM EST


Macedo Marketing is a performance-driven paid ads agency working with eCommerce and digital product brands in tier-one markets.


We’re hiring an Account Manager who can own client communication end-to-end, keep things calm when results fluctuate, and drive retention through clarity, trust, and solid execution.


About Macedo Marketing

  • We help eCommerce and digital product brands grow through paid advertising and creative strategy.
  • We’re direct, high standards, and process-driven. We care about results, but we also care about how we get them: honest communication, clear ownership, and no drama.
  • You’ll work closely with media buyers and creatives, but you’ll own the client relationship.


The Role

  • As an Account Manager, your job is to keep 15–20 clients aligned, confident, and moving forward. This is not a “smile and reassure” role. It’s a client-trust role.
  • You’ll lead client calls, handle day-to-day communication, translate performance into clear updates, and make sure the internal team is aligned on what matters most for each account.


Mission

Ensure clients feel confident, informed, and supported while achieving strong performance outcomes, leading to long-term retention and account growth.


Success looks like

  • Clients stay longer because they trust you
  • Issues get handled early, not after clients complain
  • Performance dips don’t turn into chaos
  • Clients understand what’s happening and what’s next
  • Upsell opportunities are spotted and surfaced responsibly


What You’ll Do

  • Own client communication and calls for your book of accounts (15–20 clients)
  • Run weekly or bi-weekly calls with clear structure, next steps, and accountability
  • Translate performance updates into clear, honest client communication


When performance dips:

  • Calmly explain the situation to the client with facts and context
  • Push internally for clarity and corrective action with the media buyer/creative team
  • Keep timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups clean and tracked
  • Make sure client questions don’t sit unanswered
  • Spot upsell and expansion opportunities and flag them internally
  • Collect testimonials / positive feedback at the right moments


This Will Be For You If…

  • You have 3+ years in account management / client success (agency experience is a strong plus)
  • You’re native or fully fluent in English and comfortable leading client calls
  • You’re calm under pressure and don’t take client stress personally
  • You’re organized, detail-oriented, and move fast on important tasks
  • You don’t overpromise to “make the client happy” — you align internally first
  • You’re curious about paid ads and want to deepen your understanding of Meta/Google fundamentals
  • You can handle a client load of 15–20 without dropping quality


Do Not Apply If…

  • You tend to procrastinate or take too long to handle time-sensitive issues
  • You leave client questions unanswered or avoid uncomfortable conversations
  • You “smooth things over” by making commitments without internal approval
  • You’re not interested in learning the basics of paid ads and how our delivery process works
  • You need constant supervision to stay organized


Why Join Macedo Marketing

  • Clear expectations and ownership: you’ll know what “good” tells like here
  • Direct access to leadership: fast decisions, no corporate layers
  • High standards, low drama: we care about performance and professionalism
  • 100% remote: work from anywhere, as long as you overlap 8 AM–4 PM EST
  • Growth path: this role can develop into a Senior AM / Client Lead position
  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience. We’ll ask for expectations in the application.


How to Apply

  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • We’ll send a short application form to shortlisted candidates
  • First interview for standout applications
  • We move quickly with the right people.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.

  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.

Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Paralegal Junior
description:
A Cunha Law PLLC é um escritório de advocacia americano sediado em Washington, DC, dedicado ao direito de imigração e negócios, com forte atuação em imigração de negócios e atendimento à comunidade brasileira nos Estados Unidos e no exterior. Assessoramos empresas, investidores, executivos e profissionais qualificados em toda a gama de matérias da área — vistos de trabalho (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN), vistos de investidor (E-2, EB-5), residência permanente baseada em emprego (EB-1, EB-2, NIW, PERM), abertura e estruturação de empresas nos EUA, além de petições familiares, naturalização e atuação contenciosa. Operamos com o padrão técnico de um escritório de primeira linha e o suporte de uma estrutura moderna, orientada por tecnologia e processos.

Não somos uma consultoria de imigração e não competimos com despachantes.  Esse posicionamento define tudo o que fazemos. O mercado brasileiro de imigração americana é dominado por intermediários que preenchem formulários, repassam o trabalho técnico para terceiros e cobram por volume — e é exatamente isso que não somos.

Estamos contratando um(a) paralegal de imigração para assumir uma carteira ativa de casos. Você será responsável por conduzir os casos do início ao fim, em coordenação com o restante do time.



Nossa Cultura — Leia com Atenção Antes de se Candidatar

Na Cunha Law, cultura não é slogan de parede — é o critério pelo qual contratamos, avaliamos e decidimos quem permanece no time. Nossos clientes são empresas e profissionais que tomam decisões estratégicas a partir do nosso trabalho: contratações internacionais, expansões para os Estados Unidos, mudanças de país, investimentos de capital, transferências de executivos. Quando um cliente nos contrata, ele está colocando nas nossas mãos não apenas um processo administrativo, mas o cronograma de um negócio, a continuidade de uma carreira, a estabilidade de uma família. Para nós, todo dia é o dia mais importante da vida de um cliente  — e por isso tratamos cada formulário, cada prazo e cada e-mail com a seriedade que o futuro de um negócio ou de uma carreira exige. Não existe caso \"pequeno\" aqui: existe o caso de alguém, e ele merece o mesmo nível de cuidado técnico que daríamos ao caso mais complexo do escritório.


E, acima de tudo, contratamos por talento, não por pedigree. Damos chances reais a profissionais que escritórios maiores ignoram — pessoas vindas de cidades pequenas, de faculdades sem nome de marca, de trajetórias menos lineares — porque acreditamos que o talento está distribuído de forma muito mais ampla do que as oportunidades. Mas o nível é alto e ele não baixa. Não estamos construindo um \"escritório bom para o tamanho que tem\"; estamos construindo um escritório que entrega no nível dos melhores da área, e quem entra no time entra para esse padrão. Se você quer um lugar que vai investir em você de verdade — em treinamento, em ferramentas, em mentoria — e que vai cobrar muito em troca, você vai se encaixar aqui. Se você procura um lugar confortável onde o esforço médio é suficiente, este não é o lugar.

Responsabilidades
  • Condução completa de casos de imigração , do intake ao deferimento, garantindo que cada etapa avance dentro do prazo e com qualidade;
  • Atendimento direto ao cliente  em português e inglês — escuta ativa, comunicação clara, empatia e resposta rápida;
  • Entrevistas de intake  e elaboração de questionários, identificando elegibilidade, riscos e documentação necessária;
  • Coleta, análise crítica e organização de documentos  apresentados pelo cliente, identificando inconsistências e solicitando complementações quando necessário;
  • Preparação de formulários USCIS  e montagem de pacotes prontos para protocolo, com índice de exhibits e cartas de apresentação;
  • Redação de cartas de apoio, declarações e memorandos  em inglês jurídico claro e bem fundamentado;
  • Pesquisa jurídica preliminar  sobre questões processuais e substantivas de imigração;
  • Suporte na elaboração de respostas a RFEs  (Requests for Evidence) e NOIDs;
  • Gestão completa da carteira no Zoho CRM e Zoho Projects  — anotações limpas, status sempre atualizado, prazos visíveis, sem pontas soltas;

Consultor Sênior de Imagens de Sistemas Operacionais  


Objetivo da posição  


Atuar na criação, hardening, empacotamento e distribuição de Golden Images corporativas, incluindo a geração de ISOs bootáveis para instalação em computadores físicos (bare-metal), garantindo padronização, segurança, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade global. 



Principais responsabilidades

  • Aplicar patches, atualizações e configurações padrão, garantindo baseline técnico e controle de versões 
  • Realizar hardening de sistemas com base em CIS Benchmark (nível 1) 
  • Gerar e validar ISOs bootáveis (bare-metal) para instalação em hardware físico 
  • Garantir compatibilidade com BIOS/UEFI, drivers essenciais e diferentes tipos de hardware 
  • Validar instalações em cenários online e offline (ou com baixa dependência de rede) 
  • Instalar, configurar e validar agentes corporativos (ex: Qualys, Tanium, Defender/CrowdStrike, Zabbix) 
  • Realizar testes de boot físico e virtual, validações funcionais e de performance 
  • Apoiar a distribuição global de imagens (ex: SFTP ou repositórios seguros) 
  • Identificar, analisar e remediar vulnerabilidades (ex: Qualys), assegurando imagens “security-ready”

Requisitos  


  • Inglês Fluente 
  • Experiência com criação e manutenção de Golden Images (Windows e Linux) 
  • Conhecimento em Windows Server 2022 (ou superior), SYSPREP e criação de mídia bootável 
  • Experiência com Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS ou similar), incluindo boot, initramfs e systemd 
  • Conhecimento em geração e validação de ISO bootável e instalações bare-metal 
  • Entendimento de conceitos de boot (BIOS vs UEFI) e validação em hardware físico 
  • Experiência com práticas de hardening e segurança, incluindo CIS Benchmark 
  • Conhecimento em gestão de vulnerabilidades (CVE, análise de risco e remediação) 
  • Experiência com instalação e validação de agentes de segurança e monitoramento 
  • Capacidade de atuar com testes técnicos, validações e troubleshooting em nível L2/L3 
  • Experiência em documentação técnica e processos de governança 



Diferenciais  


  • Experiência com ambientes virtualizados (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) 
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos (on-premise e cloud) 
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento 
  • Experiência com automação (scripts para build e configuração de imagens) 
  • Vivência em ambientes globais 
  • Conhecimento em ITIL / ITSM

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Sobre a Cunha Law PLLC

A Cunha Law PLLC é um escritório de advocacia americano sediado em Washington, DC, dedicado ao direito de imigração e negócios, com forte atuação em imigração de negócios e atendimento à comunidade brasileira nos Estados Unidos e no exterior. Assessoramos empresas, investidores, executivos e profissionais qualificados em toda a gama de matérias da área — vistos de trabalho (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN), vistos de investidor (E-2, EB-5), residência permanente baseada em emprego (EB-1, EB-2, NIW, PERM), abertura e estruturação de empresas nos EUA, além de petições familiares, naturalização e atuação contenciosa. Operamos com o padrão técnico de um escritório de primeira linha e o suporte de uma estrutura moderna, orientada por tecnologia e processos.

Não somos uma consultoria de imigração e não competimos com despachantes.  Esse posicionamento define tudo o que fazemos. O mercado brasileiro de imigração americana é dominado por intermediários que preenchem formulários, repassam o trabalho técnico para terceiros e cobram por volume — e é exatamente isso que não somos.



Nossa Cultura — Leia com Atenção Antes de se Candidatar

Na Cunha Law, cultura não é slogan de parede — é o critério pelo qual contratamos, avaliamos e decidimos quem permanece no time. Nossos clientes são empresas e profissionais que tomam decisões estratégicas a partir do nosso trabalho: contratações internacionais, expansões para os Estados Unidos, mudanças de país, investimentos de capital, transferências de executivos. Quando um cliente nos contrata, ele está colocando nas nossas mãos não apenas um processo administrativo, mas o cronograma de um negócio, a continuidade de uma carreira, a estabilidade de uma família. Para nós, todo dia é o dia mais importante da vida de um cliente  — e por isso tratamos cada formulário, cada prazo e cada e-mail com a seriedade que o futuro de um negócio ou de uma carreira exige. Não existe caso \"pequeno\" aqui: existe o caso de alguém, e ele merece o mesmo nível de cuidado técnico que daríamos ao caso mais complexo do escritório.


E, acima de tudo, contratamos por talento, não por pedigree. Damos chances reais a profissionais que escritórios maiores ignoram — pessoas vindas de cidades pequenas, de faculdades sem nome de marca, de trajetórias menos lineares — porque acreditamos que o talento está distribuído de forma muito mais ampla do que as oportunidades. Mas o nível é alto e ele não baixa. Não estamos construindo um \"escritório bom para o tamanho que tem\"; estamos construindo um escritório que entrega no nível dos melhores da área, e quem entra no time entra para esse padrão. Se você quer um lugar que vai investir em você de verdade — em treinamento, em ferramentas, em mentoria — e que vai cobrar muito em troca, você vai se encaixar aqui. Se você procura um lugar confortável onde o esforço médio é suficiente, este não é o lugar.


obre a Vaga

Estamos contratando um(a) profissional de recepção e atendimento comercial  para ser o primeiro ponto de contato do escritório com novos clientes. Você é a porta de entrada da Cunha Law: a voz no telefone, a resposta no WhatsApp, o e-mail de boas-vindas. Sua missão é receber cada lead com excelência, qualificar a oportunidade, agendar a consulta com o advogado e acompanhar o cliente até a assinatura do contrato.

Responsabilidades
  • Atendimento de leads em todos os canais  — telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, formulários do site, redes sociais — com resposta rápida, postura profissional e acolhimento
  • Qualificação de leads  — entender a situação do cliente, identificar o tipo de visto ou serviço aplicável, e direcionar corretamente
  • Agendamento de consultas  com o advogado, garantindo que cada consulta chegue preparada (informações coletadas, documentos prévios, contexto registrado)
  • Follow-up estruturado  com leads que ainda não fecharam — sem perder ninguém no meio do caminho
  • Envio de propostas comerciais  preparadas pelo escritório, com explicação clara dos serviços e dos valores
  • Acompanhamento da jornada do cliente  desde o primeiro contato até a assinatura do contrato e o pagamento da entrada
  • Gestão completa do funil comercial no CRM  — cada lead registrado, cada interação anotada, cada etapa atualizada, sem pontas soltas
  • Coordenação do calendário do advogado  para consultas e reuniões
  • Comunicação clara e impecável em português e inglês , escrita e falada — você representa o escritório
  • Suporte administrativo de recepção  — encaminhamento de chamadas, triagem de e-mails do contato geral, organização da agenda comercial
  • Reporte semanal de métricas comerciais  — leads recebidos, consultas agendadas, contratos fechados, taxas de conversão
  • Identificação de oportunidades de Wow Factor  em cada interação com cliente potencial



Requirements

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo  (qualquer área)
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência  em atendimento comercial, recepção, vendas consultivas, SDR, customer success ou função correlata
Tem menos de 1 ano de experiência mas acredita que tem o perfil certo? Candidate-se mesmo assim. Valorizamos talento e disposição para aprender.
  • Inglês fluente — escrito e falado  (essencial e não-negociável; você vai atender clientes americanos por telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail todos os dias)
  • Português nativo
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita  — clareza, cordialidade e profissionalismo
  • Perfil consultivo, não agressivo  — sabemos que vendas em direito não funcionam como vendas de varejo; o que funciona é escuta, confiança e competência
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário comercial dos Estados Unidos  (fuso de Washington, DC) e seguir o calendário americano de feriados
  • Disponibilidade para emitir nota fiscal como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Estrutura de home office adequada — internet estável, computador, headset de qualidade, ambiente silencioso
  • Organização rigorosa — capacidade de gerenciar dezenas de leads simultâneos sem perder follow-ups
  • Conforto com tecnologia — disposição para aprender novas ferramentas rapidamente
Diferenciais (Preferenciais)
  • Espanhol  (escrito e falado) — atendemos também clientes hispanofalantes
  • Experiência prévia em escritório de advocacia, consultoria ou serviços profissionais
  • Experiência prévia com direito de imigração americano  ou conhecimento básico de vistos
  • Experiência com a plataforma Zoho  (CRM, especialmente)
  • Vivência internacional ou experiência prévia atendendo público nos EUA
  • Background em vendas consultivas B2B ou atendimento a clientes de alto valor



Benefits

O que Oferecemos:

  • Contrato PJ, pagamento mensal em reais — fixo + variável  atrelado a metas de conversão
  • 100% remoto a partir do Brasil
  • Curso de aperfeiçoamento de inglês custeado pelo escritório  — investimos no contínuo desenvolvimento do seu inglês profissional
  • Treinamento estruturado em direito de imigração americano, suficiente para você qualificar leads com competência
  • Stack moderno de tecnologia — Zoho CRM, telefonia integrada, WhatsApp Business, sem caos operacional
  • Espaço real de crescimento para coordenação comercial conforme o time cresce
  • Trabalho com propósito, em uma área que muda a vida das pessoas

title: Title Researcher (U.S. Real Estate)
description:
Job title: Title Researcher (U.S. Real Estate)

Type of employment: Full-time

Shift Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00AM – 7:00PM US Central Time


A specialized research role focused on identifying heirs, confirming ownership, and resolving title complexity for Texas property deals. You will conduct hands-on genealogy research, deep recorder-of-deeds investigations, and public records work to produce a complete, caller-ready research packet—so the sales and calling team can move cases forward without back-and-forth. Experience in genealogical research, property title investigation, probate, or U.S. public records research is highly preferred.


About the Company

A real estate acquisition firm specializing in resolving complex property issues—such as probate, liens, and title defects—to create win-win outcomes for heirs and owners of distressed Texas properties.


Objectives of this Role

  • Accurate Identification: Produce comprehensive heirship profiles and contact pathways through professional genealogy.
  • Title Intelligence: Execute \"Track B\" deep-dive investigations to surface hidden defects and opportunities invisible to standard searches.
  • Operational Efficiency: Deliver structured, \"caller-ready\" research packets to the sales team to minimize back-and-forth and accelerate closing.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Resolve bottlenecks through expert-level skip tracing and public records forensics.


Responsibilities

  • Genealogy & Heir Identification: Verify owner deaths via obituaries and public records; build family trees using Ancestry.com and alternative indicators (deed dates, court records).
  • Title Chain Research (Track A & B): Conduct full Title Intelligence Profile (TIP) investigations. Trace ownership via grantor/grantee and legal descriptions, analyze all recorded instruments, and flag breaks in chain or unreleased liens.
  • Public Records Investigation: Scour probate, tax, divorce, bankruptcy (PACER), and Secretary of State records to validate entity and individual status.
  • Advanced Skip Tracing: Locate hard-to-find heirs using social media and non-standard digital forensics; verify all data against the heir profile.
  • CRM Documentation & Curative Support: Record structured findings in Podio ; identify required curative instruments (e.g., Affidavits of Heirship) and outline resolution paths.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Genealogy Expertise: Professional experience building family trees and navigating birth/death/marriage/divorce records.
  • Advanced Title Search: Proven ability to read and interpret complex recorded documents and identify hidden title defects.
  • Public Records Proficiency: Mastery of county recorder portals, probate courts, and federal (PACER) databases.
  • Analytical Documentation: Ability to summarize complex legal/familial findings into concise, actionable English notes.
  • Technical Tools: High proficiency in Ancestry.com and skip tracing platforms (TLO, Batch, or similar).


Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Prior experience in U.S. Title Curative or Texas-specific property research.
  • Experience with Podio CRM.
  • Background in estate law, probate, or professional heir-hunting.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.

  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.

  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

description:

This role is ideal for someone who can work independently while delivering high-impact, data-driven product outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

  • Support data-driven decision-making by defining KPIs, analyzing user feedback and product metrics, conducting basic A/B testing when needed, and continuously optimizing product performance.

·      Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges strategically in the context of data architecture and scalability.

Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?
